intro: You begin Exploring the Alliance in Stormwind Keep, then travel to meet the rulers of Ironforge and Darnassus. Their lands show the breadth of the Alliance before you turn toward Westfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn.
Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I hope your adventures have given you a sense of the scale and wonder of our world. I know it must seem overwhelming to you, but if you are to help your people, you must be prepared for whatever may come your way while you are on Azeroth.

While you wait for your order to establish itself in Dalaran, I suggest you turn your attention to the lands around Stormwind. Westfall in particular can always use more strong adventurers to lend them aid, if you are willing.
